katie-support: FYI escalation from Acme SRE — getting 401 invalid_api_key on /v1/chat/completions. Customer pasted a whole file they downloaded from the dashboard. Repro attached, looks like the request sent the header with the file wrapper lines.

acme-sre: reproducer:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer -----BEGIN REDWOOD API KEY-----\nmeta: user=alice\nsk_live_ABCDEF1234567890\n-----END REDWOOD API KEY-----" \ "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

katie-support: customer says they clicked the download button in the dashboard (not the little "copy key" button) and pasted the whole blob into their CI secret. They don't see any visible error on their side, just 401.

ryan-eng: can you paste the full raw request ID from the response headers and the org id? I can check validator logs.

acme-sre: got `x-redwood-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d` and org `acme-123`. Response body: `{"error":{"message":"invalid_api_key","type":"authentication_error"}}`.

logsbot: found validator rejection for req_0a1b2c3d — reason: token format contains non-alphanumeric characters (prefix lines). Token parser expects ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}$ (no whitespace or header markers).

matt-ops: quick triage: this is a user mistake (downloaded keyfile with headers). Not a platform regression. However, we should make error message clearer. The API currently returns generic `invalid_api_key`. Recommend augmenting message to `invalid_api_key: malformed key, remove header/footer lines` for cases where parser sees the typical begin/end boundaries. Filing a small follow-up bug.

ryan-eng: agreed. For now, katie — provide the customer these options: 1) in CI secret, replace the entire blob with the bare token line (sk_live_...), or 2) use the dashboard "copy key" button which copies the bare token. Also include a curl snippet showing the correct header: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABCDEF1234567890" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

katie-support: sent both fixes to customer, included request id and a screenshot of where to find the "copy key" button. They tried option 1 and verified calls now succeed.

acme-sre: confirmed — calls pass now, no more 401. Thanks! :tada:

katie-support: closing the escalation. Filed ENG-4521 to make validator error clearer and added a small note to the dashboard download modal to warn about including header/footer when storing in CI.

matt-ops: +1 on the dashboard note. Small UX win.
